Type: industrial console table
Use: display and drop zone behind a sofa or in an entryway; living room, hallway
Style: industrial, rustic, modern
Materials: solid wood plank top in a walnut stain, black powder-coated steel frame
Colors: warm medium walnut brown, matte black
Shape: long narrow rectangular top, slim square metal legs, low H-shaped stretcher, open frame without drawers, light and airy
Feel: warm, sturdy, urban
Goes with: leather, black metal, exposed brick, warm wood; industrial or loft living rooms

Type: two-drawer console table
Use: storage and display in an entryway or behind a sofa; hallway, living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic, farmhouse
Materials: painted wood, plank-style top, round metal knobs
Colors: white, silver knobs
Shape: rectangular overhanging top, two front drawers, curved cabriole legs, side stretchers, medium size, light visual weight
Feel: bright, charming, soft
Goes with: pastel or neutral walls, silver or glass accents; cottage, French country or classic rooms

Type: tall oak side table

Style: rustic, farmhouse, traditional

Colors: light warm honey oak, black iron
Shape: small square top with rounded edges, single drawer, lower shelf, four square tapered legs, tall and compact
Feel: warm, homely, sturdy
Goes with: cream walls, wool textiles, other oak furniture; country cottage or farmhouse rooms

Type: wooden writing desk with drawers
